sentences.zh: 那天。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然了。

sentences.zh: 我们下午2点半拍的，因为那时候那边的小巷才有阴凉。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: In the alley over there.
sentences.zh: 就在那边的小巷里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But yeah, we were definitely not cold.
sentences.zh: 但没错，我们其实一点也不冷。

sentences.en: That's all really good cold acting.
sentences.zh: 那全都是非常棒的“寒冷”演技。

sentences.en: We have a fan question from Akansha C.
sentences.zh: 我们收到一个来自印度德里的粉丝阿坎莎·C的提问。

sentences.en: in Delhi, India.
sentences.zh: 阿坎莎，希望我没读错你的名字，因为这是你想问我们的问题。

sentences.en: Akansha, I hope I'm pronouncing your name correctly because here's what you'd like to throw out to us.
sentences.zh: 在开场戏里，当帕姆提醒大家这只是一张来自纸张供应商的圣诞贺卡，

sentences.en: In the cold open, when Pam reminds everyone that it's just a Christmas card from your paper supplier
sentences.zh: 而且没人会把它贴在冰箱上时，

sentences.en: and no one's going to put it on their fridge,
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了安吉拉在你们播客系列节目开头说的话，

sentences.en: it reminded me of what Angela said in the beginning of your podcast series,
sentences.zh: 她说安吉拉·金赛会把所有公司寄来的圣诞贺卡都贴出来。

sentences.en: which is that Angela Kinsey puts up all of her Christmas cards from every company.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 连我空调维修工寄来的圣诞贺卡我也贴。

sentences.en: My AC repair guy, Christmas cards going up.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So Akansha just wanted to point out that you know who would put this card on her fridge?
sentences.zh: Akansha 只是想指出，你知道是谁把这张卡片贴在冰箱上的吗？

sentences.en: Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·金西。

sentences.en: I would.
sentences.zh: 我会。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I would.
sentences.zh: 我会。

sentences.en: Especially this picture because it's a hot mess.
sentences.zh: 尤其是这张照片，简直乱七八糟的。

sentences.en: Well, the thing is, though, they didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 不过问题是，他们没看懂。

sentences.en: Oh, that was so funny.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太搞笑了。

sentences.en: Just cutting to Michael saying, we didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 直接切到 Michael 说我们没看懂。

sentences.en: When that talking head came up, I laughed so hard, like a guttural laugh that came all the way from deep in my belly.
sentences.zh: 当那个采访镜头出现时，我笑得好大声，那种从腹部深处发出的、粗犷的笑声。

sentences.en: I had to pause because I forgot that talking head and it made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 我不得不暂停一下，因为我忘了那个采访镜头，它让我笑个不停。

sentences.en: I just like Dwight running at the camera, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢 Dwight 冲向摄像头的样子。

sentences.en: It was all great.
sentences.zh: 一切都很棒。

sentences.en: Well, this episode is going to open and we are going to see a incredibly decorated office bullpen.
sentences.zh: 好了，这一集开场时，我们会看到一个装饰得不可思议的办公室办公区。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You're welcome, Pam.
sentences.zh: 不客气，Pam。

sentences.en: I had to break it down, a little decoration breakdown.
sentences.zh: 我得把它拆解一下，做个小小的装饰盘点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: At one minute, 53 seconds, I saw something new.
sentences.zh: 在一分五十三秒的时候，我看到了新东西。

sentences.en: What was it?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: Angela has a Christmas village by her desk.
sentences.zh: Angela 的办公桌旁有一个圣诞村模型。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: Was that based on your real-life Christmas village that you like to put out?
sentences.zh: 那是基于你现实生活中喜欢摆出来的圣诞村吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so, but Jenna is correct.
sentences.zh: 我觉得不是，但 Jenna 说得对。

sentences.en: I put one out every year.
sentences.zh: 我每年都会摆一个。

sentences.en: The kids and I love it.
sentences.zh: 我和孩子们都很喜欢。

sentences.en: We add to it each year.
sentences.zh: 我们每年都会往里添东西。

sentences.en: I have a Christmas village, and then I have like a little nook that's all little mini Christmas trees because my mom makes little trees every year.
sentences.zh: 我有一个圣诞村，还有一个小角落，摆满了迷你圣诞树，因为我妈妈每年都会做些小树。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I have a couple of your mom's mini Christmas trees.
sentences.zh: 我有几棵你妈妈做的迷你圣诞树。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: They're fantastic.
sentences.zh: 它们棒极了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Here's what I saw in what we're going to call the traditional Christmas.
sentences.zh: 以下是我在所谓的“传统圣诞节”里看到的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We saw Christmas lights around the perimeter, like all multicolored lights, a big Christmas tree, a few miniature Christmas trees around the office.
sentences.zh: 我们看到四周挂着圣诞彩灯，各种颜色的灯，一棵大圣诞树，办公室周围还有几棵迷你圣诞树。

sentences.en: There's garland on the computers, ornaments hanging all over the place, red poinsettia plants, Christmas stockings at reception, a Merry Christmas banner,
sentences.zh: 电脑上缠着花环，到处挂着装饰品，摆着红色的圣诞红，前台挂着圣诞袜，还有一条“圣诞快乐”的横幅，

sentences.en: and lots of little decorative items like bears with Santa hats and an angel on Pam's desk and a giant nutcracker.
sentences.zh: 以及许多小装饰品，比如戴着圣诞帽的小熊、Pam 桌上的天使摆件，还有一个巨大的胡桃夹子。

sentences.en: Well, as Pam says in her talking head, in her role as office administrator, she automatically becomes head of the party planning committee,
sentences.zh: 正如 Pam 在采访中所说，作为办公室行政主管，她自动成为了派对策划委员会的负责人，

sentences.en: and her first order of business was to shut it down.
sentences.zh: 而她上任后的第一件事就是将其解散。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It was basically a toxic political club used to make others feel miserable and left out.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就是一个有毒的政治俱乐部，用来让别人感到痛苦和被排挤。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Did you notice the giant box that Angela hands Pam?
sentences.zh: 你注意到 Angela 交给 Pam 的那个大箱子了吗？

sentences.en: She's very sad to hand it over to her.
sentences.zh: 她交出去的时候非常难过。

sentences.en: The one that Pam throws in the dumpster?
sentences.zh: 就是 Pam 扔进垃圾桶里的那个？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: On the side, it says party planning committee, minutes and notes.
sentences.zh: 侧面写着“派对策划委员会，会议记录和笔记”。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What I would give to read some of those notes.
sentences.zh: 我真希望能读到那些笔记中的一些内容。

sentences.en: Well, that day that I threw away the box, and I'm wearing a coat, and I'm again pretending like I'm cold, that was the same day that we did the picture outside.
sentences.zh: 那天我扔掉盒子的时候，我穿着外套，又在假装自己很冷，那正是我们在外面拍照的那一天。

sentences.en: It was 93 degrees.
sentences.zh: 当时有93华氏度（约34摄氏度）。

sentences.en: We were just a bunch of sweaty folks.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就是一群汗流浃背的人。

sentences.en: Well, I couldn't help but notice Pam's adorable sweater.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住注意到了帕姆那件可爱的毛衣。

sentences.en: It's like this cardigan with reindeer and it's kind of a maroonish red.
sentences.zh: 那是一件印着驯鹿的开衫，颜色是那种暗红色的。

sentences.en: It's so cute.
sentences.zh: 太可爱了。

sentences.en: I wanted that sweater.
sentences.zh: 我当时想要那件毛衣。

sentences.en: I begged to keep that sweater.
sentences.zh: 我恳求过把那件毛衣留下来。

sentences.en: And you couldn't have it?
sentences.zh: 结果你没能留住？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: It was a rental from Universal Costumes.
sentences.zh: 那是从环球影业服装部租来的。

sentences.en: Alicia said it was one of a kind and we had to give it back.
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚说那是独一无二的，我们必须归还。

sentences.en: You can't buy it anywhere.
sentences.zh: 你在任何地方都买不到。

sentences.en: Oh, I know.
sentences.zh: 噢，我知道。

sentences.en: Because I was going to surprise you.
sentences.zh: 因为我本来想给你个惊喜。

sentences.en: I was going to find it.
sentences.zh: 我本来打算把它找出来的。

sentences.en: But you can't.
sentences.zh: 但你找不到的。

sentences.en: It's not on the internet.
sentences.zh: 网上根本没有。

sentences.en: And there's like some kind of knockoff versions, but they don't look anything like it.
sentences.zh: 虽然有一些仿制品，但看起来一点都不像。

sentences.en: It fit perfectly, too.
sentences.zh: 而且它穿起来还特别合身。

sentences.en: And I loved the little pink button down that she had me wear underneath it.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢她让我穿在里面的那件粉色衬衫。

sentences.en: Yeah, the pink with the red.
sentences.zh: 没错，粉色配红色。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So cute.
sentences.zh: 太可爱了。

sentences.en: Well, here's a holiday outfit breakdown for you guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在给你们盘点一下节日服装。

sentences.en: We're going to have lots of different outfits this episode.
sentences.zh: 这一集里我们会有很多不同的装扮。

sentences.en: But we have Christmas ties, vests, sweaters, suspenders, bow ties, and lots and lots of Christmas pins.
sentences.zh: 我们有圣诞领带、背心、毛衣、背带、领结，还有许许多多的圣诞胸针。

sentences.en: Yeah, you have on a Christmas tree Christmas pin.
sentences.zh: 没错，你戴着一个圣诞树形状的圣诞胸针。

sentences.en: And then later, Pam has one for her second Christmas outfit.
sentences.zh: 后来，帕姆在她的第二套圣诞装扮里也戴了一个。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Did you notice Gabe wears a Santa pin?
sentences.zh: 你注意到盖博戴了一个圣诞老人胸针吗？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我没注意到。

sentences.en: Phyllis has a bejeweled kind of snowflake pin.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯戴的是那种镶满珠宝的雪花胸针。

sentences.en: Erin has a wreath.
sentences.zh: 艾琳戴的是花环。

sentences.en: Meredith has a pin.
sentences.zh: 梅雷迪思也戴了一个胸针。

sentences.en: Everyone is all decked out for the holidays except for one person.
sentences.zh: 每个人都为了节日盛装打扮，除了一个人。

sentences.en: Did you notice?
sentences.zh: 你注意到了吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't notice anyone not wearing a Christmas item.
sentences.zh: 没有，我没注意到有人没戴圣诞饰品。

sentences.en: For traditional Christmas, there's one person who did not dress up at all.
sentences.zh: 在传统圣诞节里，有一个人完全没有打扮。

sentences.en: Who?
sentences.zh: 谁？

sentences.en: Daryl.
sentences.zh: 达里尔。

sentences.en: He is in a beige button-down shirt and a beige t-shirt underneath.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件米色衬衫，里面是一件米色T恤。

sentences.en: What's up, Daryl?
sentences.zh: 达里尔，你怎么回事？

sentences.en: Don't know.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: Zero festiveness.
sentences.zh: 毫无节日气氛。

sentences.en: He comes around later, though.
sentences.zh: 不过他后来还是融入进来了。

sentences.en: I'll tell you what.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说。

sentences.en: But I wear a pin and Christmas earring combo every Christmas Eve.
sentences.zh: 但我每年平安夜都会戴上一套胸针和圣诞耳环。

sentences.en: It's a must in my family.
sentences.zh: 这是我们家的必备传统。

sentences.en: We wear Christmas pajamas.
sentences.zh: 我们穿圣诞睡衣。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We get all decked out in our jammies.
sentences.zh: 我们都会穿上睡衣，打扮得漂漂亮亮的。

sentences.en: Speaking of ties, we had a fan question from Katie P.
sentences.zh: 说到领带，我们收到了一位来自伦敦的粉丝凯蒂·P的提问。

sentences.en: in London.
sentences.zh: 来自伦敦。

sentences.en: Is the tie that Jim is wearing in this episode the same one that Kevin wears in Benihana Christmas?
sentences.zh: 吉姆在这一集中戴的领带和凯文在《班尼哈纳圣诞节》里戴的是同一条吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我觉得不是。

sentences.en: It is not, but they are almost identical.
sentences.zh: 确实不是，但它们几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: They're very similar.
sentences.zh: 它们非常相似。

sentences.en: It's sad that I knew that immediately.
sentences.zh: 我能一眼看出来，真够悲哀的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I had to do a whole side-by-side.
sentences.zh: 我不得不做了一个完整的对比图。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: They both were blue, and they both have, like, the snowmen on the bottom, but they were different.
sentences.zh: 它们都是蓝色的，底部都有雪人，但它们是不一样的。

sentences.en: This is correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They also have, like, white snowflakes.
sentences.zh: 它们上面还有白色的雪花。

sentences.en: White snowflakes, yeah.
sentences.zh: 白色的雪花，是的。

sentences.en: And then when you get to the very bottom, there's a snowman.
sentences.zh: 然后在最底部有一个雪人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But isn't Kevin's snowman kind of just like a jolly snowman, but, like, Jim's snowman is doing some kind of action?
sentences.zh: 但凯文的雪人是不是那种很开心的雪人，而吉姆的雪人是在做某种动作？

sentences.en: Well, both snowmen are just holding brooms, but they're totally different brooMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，两个雪人都拿着扫帚，但那是完全不同的扫帚。

sentences.en: Jim's snowman has a top hat and a red and white scarf, and Kevin's from Benihana Christmas has a top hat and a blue tie.
sentences.zh: 吉姆的雪人戴着高礼帽，围着红白相间的围巾，而凯文在《班尼哈纳圣诞节》里的雪人戴着高礼帽，系着蓝色领带。

sentences.en: And I have a picture of him side-by-side, so if you want a visual, you need to head over to Office Ladies Pod.
sentences.zh: 我有一张它们的对比照，如果你想看图，请前往Office Ladies Pod。

sentences.en: Give it to me.
sentences.zh: 给我看看。

sentences.en: I'll post it.
sentences.zh: 我会发出来的。

sentences.en: Every week on Wednesdays, Angela painstakingly builds these amazing visual stories to go along with our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 每周三，安吉拉都会煞费苦心地制作这些精彩的视觉故事，来配合我们的播客。

sentences.en: Go subscribe to Office Ladies Pod so that you see this stuff.
sentences.zh: 去订阅Office Ladies Pod，这样你就能看到这些内容了。

sentences.en: I mean, if you need to see these ties side-by-side, you can over on Office Ladies Pod Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你需要看这些领带的对比图，可以去Office Ladies Pod的Instagram上看。

sentences.en: Thanks, lady.
sentences.zh: 谢了，女士。

sentences.en: I don't know why I enjoy it so much, but I really do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我这么乐在其中，但我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: Well, you do a great job.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你做得非常棒。

sentences.en: Well, thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And people should know about it.
sentences.zh: 大家应该知道这一点。

sentences.en: I had a few favorite outfits in this traditional Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 在这个传统的圣诞派对上，我有几套最喜欢的装扮。

sentences.en: One, obviously, Pam's sweater.
sentences.zh: 第一，显而易见，帕姆的毛衣。

sentences.en: But I thought Kelly looked fantastic.
sentences.zh: 但我认为凯莉看起来棒极了。

sentences.en: She had that red silk blouse and then sort of a bejeweled necklace and then this black and white tweed skirt.
sentences.zh: 她穿着那件红色丝绸衬衫，戴着一条镶满珠宝的项链，还有那条黑白粗花呢裙子。

sentences.en: And I thought, I want that outfit.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，我想要那套衣服。

sentences.en: Yeah, I kind of want to steal that for my next Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我下次参加圣诞派对也想穿那套。

sentences.en: Well, one of the things I loved about doing our Christmas episodes was you would walk on set and it would be just instantly Christmas, even though it was summertime usually.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢拍摄圣诞特辑的原因之一，就是你一走进片场，立刻就能感受到圣诞气氛，尽管当时通常是夏天。

sentences.en: And I loved the Christmas tree.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢那棵圣诞树。

sentences.en: Every year they put it in the exact same spot.
sentences.zh: 每年他们都把它放在同一个位置。

sentences.en: And I like that because we do that at home.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样，因为我们在家里也是这么做的。

sentences.en: The tree has its spot.
sentences.zh: 树有它固定的位置。

sentences.en: And I thought this tree looked amazing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这棵树看起来棒极了。

sentences.en: They really decorated it a lot.
sentences.zh: 他们真的装饰得很用心。

sentences.en: They got the lights the right size.
sentences.zh: 他们选的灯光大小正合适。

sentences.en: Sorry, Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，菲利斯。

sentences.en: Jim is very impressed and he says, how does this fake tree smell like a real tree?
sentences.zh: 吉姆印象非常深刻，他说，这棵假树怎么会有真树的味道？

sentences.en: And Pam has a little fake tree hack.
sentences.zh: 帕姆有个装饰假树的小妙招。

sentences.en: Yeah, she has a pine-scented air freshener like the kind that you hang from your rearview mirror in your car.
sentences.zh: 没错，她用了一个松木味的空气清新剂，就是那种挂在汽车后视镜上的。

sentences.en: She's like tucked it inside.
sentences.zh: 她把它塞进了树里。

sentences.en: Smart.
sentences.zh: 聪明。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: We got a fan question from Javen L.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一个来自特立尼达的粉丝杰文·L的提问。

sentences.en: in Trinidad.
sentences.zh: 在特立尼达。

sentences.en: I can't wait for the deep dive on the little tree car freshener.
sentences.zh: 我等不及要听关于那个小树汽车清新剂的深度解析了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 首先，我特别喜欢这种迈克尔在办公室里说话，然后镜头一转揭示出其实一直有人在旁边的桥段。

sentences.en: Because Kara says, on my millionth rewatch, it stood out to me as sounding like an Angela Kinsey improv, which always make me laugh.
sentences.zh: 因为Kara说，在她看了无数遍之后，那句台词听起来特别像安吉拉·金赛的即兴创作，每次都能把她逗笑。

sentences.en: Thanks, Kara.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Kara。

sentences.zh: 然后我说，是的，他是。

sentences.en: And Michael said, okay.

sentences.en: So we improvised the whole end of the scene.
sentences.zh: 所以我们把整场戏的结尾都即兴发挥了。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: But it was really fun.

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, Angela, I have all the details about the making of that comic book, but I'm going to wait.

sentences.zh: 他走过会议室窗户，背景是窗外的布景。

sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔在踱步。

sentences.zh: 他在等霍莉。

sentences.zh: 他为她的到来感到非常焦虑，然后他意识到，天哪，竟然有一棵假圣诞树。

sentences.zh: 在“高雅圣诞节”上怎么能用假圣诞树呢。

sentences.zh: 尤其是对于一个来自新罕布什尔州的人来说。

sentences.zh: 所以他给了帕姆一些钱，让她立刻去买一棵真树。

sentences.zh: 约翰·卡拉辛斯基没在状态。

sentences.zh: 我觉得他当时正在办公区对面和布莱恩·鲍姆加特纳聊天。

sentences.en: Really?

sentences.zh: 她将在第八季中以贾斯汀的身份出现。
